risks.risk: Exact make/model (and therefore correct market comparables) is not readable; pricing could be wrong if it's not the claimed model.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/brand badge and the VIN/serial plate (and/or dashboard/odometer screen) in one frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown 3-wheel trike in average condition (worst-case vs claimed model), not as the specific 'Ryker'.

risks.risk: Tyre condition may not be brand new (could be worn, patched, or mismatched).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all tyre sidewalls and tread (front + both rears), plus a photo of the tyre DOT date codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres not guaranteed new (worst-case: needs replacement soon).

risks.risk: Mechanical condition/working status is unknown (engine, brakes, lights, steering, reverse/gear).
risks.proof: Video of a cold start, idling, and a short ride/slow maneuver showing brakes and indicators working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not verified for working condition (worst-case: needs inspection/repairs).

risks.risk: Custom duty/ownership documentation may be missing or not match the bike (risk of seizure/ownership disputes).
risks.proof: Photos/scans of customs/duty documents and any Nigerian registration/ownership papers (if available), plus VIN match to documents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as documentation not confirmed (worst-case: treat as higher risk/needs full verification).

risks.risk: Tampering/accident repair may exist (frame alignment, welds, non-original parts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints/welds, engine mounts, and suspension/steering linkage from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially tampered/unknown history (worst-case: discount for possible repairs).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the brand/model badge and the VIN/serial plate (and odometer/dashboard reading).
Video: cold start + lights/indicators + horn + brake test (and short ride).
Close-up photos of all tyres (tread + sidewall) including DOT date codes.
Photos/scans of customs/duty documents and any registration/ownership papers; VIN match to documents.
response.reason: From photo 0, the bike is clearly a 3-wheel trike, but the claimed 'Tokunbo' and specific 'Ryker' identity, tyre-new status, and tamper/custom-duty claims are not verifiable remotely. Missing the identity and working/document proof prevents a confident worst-case price.
